2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Nanpur P.S. Case No. 496 of 2023 for the offence punish- able u/s 341, 323, 354B and 376 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: 3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner used to give allurement of marriage to the informant and when there was no one in her house, the petitioner forcibly entered into the house and raped the informant.

sentences.text: On alarm being raised, when the neigh- bours started assembling, the petitioner fled away from the spot leaving behind his motorcycle.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 14 March, 2024.json

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the peti- tioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

sentences.text: The FIR has been registered three days after the occurrence.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 14 March, 2024.json

sentences.text: Though there is allegation that the petitioner fled away leaving behind his motorcycle, motorcycle was not seized.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 14 March, 2024.json

sentences.text:
No person has seen the occurrence and the witness stated that they came on Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.14830 of 2024(2) dt.14-03-2024 hearing alarm and the victim/informant gave information about the said occurrence.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 14 March, 2024.json

sentences.text: The medical report has not supported the allegation and the doctor has opined that it is difficult to say whether rape has been committed or not.

sentences.text: Learned counsel fur- ther submits that the informant wanted to marry the petitioner and in order to pressurized the petitioner, this story has been de- veloped.

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits that the petitioner is a student of intermediate and he used to live outside.

sentences.text: 2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Nanpur P.S. Case No. 496 of 2023 registered for the offences under Sections 341, 323, 354(B) and 376 of the IPC.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: 3. The petitioner is named in the F.I.R. and is in custody since 17.04.2025.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: 4. The allegation against the petitioner is to commit rape upon informant/victim.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that on the alleged date of occurrence informant was admittedly major as per school certificate and as per medical report victim was found between the age group of 20-22 years.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is submitted that admittedly this case was not registered under Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.54666 of 2025(3) dt.03-11-2025 POCSO Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is also submitted that informant was in love with petitioner and she was regularly talking with him.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is submitted that when relationship of petitioner and informant came into the knowledge of her parents, present false case was lodged.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is pointed out that reason behind lodging present case is also non- solemnization of marriage with petitioner, and therefore, this case which was lodged when marriage of petitioner could not solemnize with informant/victim.
sentences._hearing_file: Md. Yusuf vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025.json

7.

In view of aforesaid factual submission and by taking note of fact as prima-facie allegation of rape against petitioner appears to be raised in the background of false promise of marriage, coupled with the fact as petitioner remains in custody Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.54666 of 2025(3)
dt.03-11-2025 since 17.04.2025, accordingly above named petitioner, is directed to be released on bail in connection with Nanpur P.S. Case No. 496 of 2023 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-
